title: Graph tab shell: runs, services, new run (with the decision-log gate), poll, cancel / abandon, drawing
what:
graph/index.js shows the run view when a run is picked or running, otherwise the turn graph (one stub import that W3 fills).
graph/runs.js signals, every poll through core/lane.js's hubPoll:
- GET /hub/runs; start; answer; cancel; abandon
- poll log?after=N every 1 s while running and the tab is visible, every 5 s while parked; stop when the run ends
- health every 10 s while visible
graph/view.js, top to bottom:
- services line, e.g. 'jev ● up · jevlike jev-base-v0.pt (weights present; loads on first call) · openjev weights present (loads on first call, ~24 s) · decision log off · browser ● up'
  - 'checkpoint: unknown' when /health lacks ckpt
  - a down service shows its start command as text; nothing in the page starts a service
- runs list; `[ new run ]` (graph menu from /hub/runs/graphs, one field per string param, `[ run ]`)
  - while jev's decision log is not off, `[ run ]` is greyed with R1a's sentence and the start command ('jev is logging decisions for training; restart it with JEV_DECISIONS_LOG=off: …'); a 409 from the perch shows the same sentence
  - while a run is parked, new run says why and offers `[ abandon ]`
- the drawing with the current state lit
- a status sentence, the path (Cat → …), budgets left
- `[ cancel ]` while running
- 'model spend: none' (red if any)
- steps come from W2b-2's slot
tests:
runs.test.mjs:
- the poll interval per state
- the after-cursor never goes backwards and has no duplicates across overlapping polls
- answer payloads are 0-based index strings as the park prompt prints them (interp.rn:406-449), or 'stop'
- the parked-cap message
- the decision-log gate: off enables run; a path, a missing field and 'down' each disable it with the sentence
live_check:
fake perch on PORT=48125, with fake_eidolon replaying F0 at FAKE_WORKFLOW_STEP_MS=700 and a test jev /health:
- start from the page; steps arrive and the lit state moves; cancel
- abandon a parked run, then start another
- flip the test /health to a log path: `[ run ]` greys with the sentence
- widths of 34 and 72 cells
- console clean; screenshots to scratch
risk: Space in the inspector is tight; keep the header to 4 lines.
